# Brand Vision

Test fixture for validator tests.

## Words We Avoid

| Word/Phrase | Why | Use Instead |
|-------------|-----|-------------|
| **Synergy** | Corporate filler | Say what actually combines |
| **Revolutionary / game-changing** | Hype | Describe the specific change |
| **Platform** | Vague | Name the product capability |

## Voice

Plain, direct, specific.
